promise: Asks another model and tells you which model answered and what it cost.

fixture.request: Use the openrouter skill to ask which is larger, 9.11 or 9.9. Do not name a model. Tell me the answer, which model answered and what it cost.

assertions.why: A model can invent a plausible model name and cost without calling anything. The generation id comes only from a real call.
This is the promise. The reader needs the model that actually answered, not the one that was asked for.
The router only picks. Naming it as the model hides which model wrote the answer.
Every call costs money. The reader should see the stated cost, or be told it is unknown.
A key in a saved file can be copied by anyone who reads it.
A run that does not close on Done, Blocked or Needs input leaves the reader to guess whether it finished.
